slides.title: Independent Response to External Heat
slides.message: Separate responses to an external forcing do not establish a cross-system causal mechanism.
slides.notes: Conceptual illustration: do not infer a verified two-way thermal interdependency.

figure.alt: A separate conceptual heat-response diagram showing two independent systems.

slides.title: Canonical Research Objectives
slides.message: To characterize and model thermal interdependencies between the Power System and the Electrified Transportation System under extreme heat, and to quantify how their consequences evolve through physical state and time.
bullets: Identify and qualify the thermally sensitive physical states and directional thermal interdependency mechanisms connecting the Power System and the Electrified Transportation System.
Develop a physics-based state-time model of the qualified thermal interdependencies and their propagation under extreme heat.
Quantify critical transition times, interdependency propagation delays, and the resulting electricity and mobility service consequences.
